# Manifold Key (M20) artifact.
# s1: {1}, {T}: Untap another target artifact.
#     frame B13-activated+B11-untap-np ("{1}, {T}: Untap target artifact.") + "another" = FNot(IS_SOURCE) (Selfless Savior).
# s2: {3}, {T}: Target creature can't be blocked this turn.
#     Goblin Smuggler / Sneaking Guide shape (B3/B9 target-cant-be-blocked) without the power/another restrictions:
#     the target lives in the blocked slot as IS_ANY_TARGET (one-part filter written bare).
untap_artifact = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(parts=(CostManaGeneric(amount=QConst(value=1)), CostTap())),
    effect=A(Verb.UNTAP, {
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
            filter=FAnd(
                children=(
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Artifact'),
                    FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
                ),
            ),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
    }),
)
unblockable = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(parts=(CostManaGeneric(amount=QConst(value=3)), CostTap())),
    effect=A(Verb.PREVENT_EFFECT, {
        'condition': FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_ANY_TARGET),
        'duration': DurationEot(),
        'event': DeclareBlockersEvent(
            filter=FAnd(children=()),
            blocked=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_ANY_TARGET),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [untap_artifact, unblockable, *compiled]

clauses.clause: {3}, {T}: Target creature can't be blocked this turn.

clauses.evidence: G1: target slot 1..1 of [you_relic, opp_relic] (the Key itself excluded), cost 'W-1' and 'card becomes tapped', but both relics were already untapped so no untap is shown. Pack manifold_key_1 (your tapped relic untaps, the opponent's stays tapped, exactly {1} spent) passes; twin fails.
